column1: # Protocol and resource-guard cases for `borsh-spec decode` (strict mode).
# Hex must be lowercase, even length.
# Resource guard (Cost.lean): schemas whose factor exceeds 2^20 are `bad`, whatever
# the input.  A zero-sized array amplifies: (array 4294967295 unit) would produce four
# An array of non-zero-sized elements is cheap however long it is: every element
# consumes input, so a short input fails quickly.
# The factor doubles with each level of vec nesting, so the cap allows twenty levels.
# Request guard: (input length + 1) * factor must not exceed 2^26.  This schema has
# factor 1000006, so 66 input bytes are allowed and 67 are not, whatever they contain.
# The guard looks at the length of the input, not at what is consumed.
